abstract: Maintains network resilience records, uplink configurations, and peak bandwidth telemetry
system_message:
You are the Network infrastructure lead (NIL), responsible for maintaining network resilience records, uplink configurations, and peak bandwidth telemetry for host venue evaluation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains network resilience records, uplink configurations, and peak bandwidth telemetry（NETW）
information_points.content:
NIL-NETW-NUW：Granville Sound Exhibition Pavilion maintains active dual-path fiber redundancy across physically separated, diverse optical paths between the main distribution frame and metropolitan core nodes. Its provisioned peak network throughput bandwidth provides a symmetric unshared uplink of 5 Gbps during peak conference hours.
NIL-NETW-2XO：Fraser Inlet Congress Complex has active dual-path fiber redundancy operational between the facility main distribution frame and metropolitan core nodes. Its contracted peak network throughput bandwidth provides a symmetric unshared uplink of 10 Gbps during peak conference hours.
NIL-NETW-NDT：For Pacific Point Convention Centre, dual-path fiber redundancy active is true, with physically separated, diverse-path active fiber links operational between the facility main distribution frame and metropolitan core nodes. Additionally, the venue has a contracted peak network throughput bandwidth of 15 Gbps as a symmetric unshared internet uplink committed during peak conference hours.

information_points.title: Wireless coverage（WIFI）
information_points.content:
NIL-WIFI-IO7：The wireless survey register indicates that Granville Sound Exhibition Pavilion features a high-density access point count of 160 units deployed across public concourses and session rooms.
NIL-WIFI-Q6J：Fraser Inlet Congress Complex maintains a high-density access point count of 120 units across all public concourses and session rooms based on the wireless survey register.
NIL-WIFI-70Q：According to the wireless survey register, Pacific Point Convention Centre has a high-density access point count of 80 units deployed across all public concourses and session rooms.
